note: vespera-bridge: a WebFlux streaming worker whose uncaught-exception handler throws no longer dies still counted (later streams were never run), and a failed Thread.start no longer rejects or frees the slot of a stream another worker already took. The native loader extracts, verifies and loads the library through the real path of its base directory, the same chain whose ancestors it checks (a symbolic link in the middle of vespera.native.dir could otherwise be swapped). Gradle plugin: an invalid nativeJarPlatforms entry is reported under that name instead of as a vespera.targets key. Test and docs fixes: header duplicate-scan tests cover the 16-name window, the demo panic tests size their body from the chunk size the bridge really uses, the HEAD smart-mode test checks Content-Length, and the JNI bench gate docs list the client_echo_text_16k mode.
